240-5470-5686-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat from step 2.

1981-4268-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1981-4268-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2645-3430-7014-7069.easyPrerequisites:
You control an untapped land.
North Pole Patrol doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-7014-7069.description:
Activate a land by using the land granted to it by Tectonic Split by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2527-4076-4279-4549-6273.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2527-4076-4279-4549-6273.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

967-3809-4094-7087-8095.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2

6602-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Tromell.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3388-4089.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3388-4089.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Moritte of the Frost and Glasspool Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3388-4089.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1580-2438-4871-5075.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

997-3249-5173-5542.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

4613-4968-7684.description:
Activate Tigra by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4499-7444-7494.easyPrerequisites: Advanced Reconstruction is at least level 3.
4499-7444-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying {R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

1362-1479-4862.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Omnath and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

4872-5144-7487.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Zealous Lorecaster and exiling Ephemerate.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1580-4050-7396.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4772-7175.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

4869-6092-7178.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
4869-6092-7178.description:
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
Resolve the Iron-Shield Elf ability.
Repeat.

5670-6458-6705.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
5670-6458-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-1115-4846-6924.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-1115-4846-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1651-4426-6751-6754-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-4426-6751-6754-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-4426-6751-6754-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

413-856-3263-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it, Blasting Station and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

38-2173-5220-5332.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

997-1580-4871-5921.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

2275-3591-5014-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2275-3591-5014-6282.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability.
Repeat.

1563-1879-2457-2557.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

654-1308-1445-2366-6413.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
654-1308-1445-2366-6413.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Green Goblin's second ability triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers twice, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Goblin you control.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2265-4120-4968.easyPrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2265-4120-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
2265-4120-4968.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

511-817-3921-4050-6441.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

4211-4772-6232.description:
Cast Tamiyo by paying {3}{U}{U}. Tamiyo enters the battlefield with eight loyalty counters on it due to Doubling Season.
Activate Tamiyo's third loyalty ability by removing eight loyalty counters from it, causing you to get its emblem.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Tamiyo's emblem triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 3.

4231-4559-4740-5670.notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 10.
4231-4559-4740-5670.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating a Food, Clue and Treasure token.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two of the artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir infinitely to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1525-2031-2406-2660-4661.notablePrerequisites:
Vesuvan Doppelganger is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-4661.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-4661.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-745-1295-1368--39.notablePrerequisites: Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-745-1295-1368--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

1456-3110-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1737-2544-2713-3390.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Lotus Bloom.
Activate the Lotus Bloom token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

876-1308-2043-2585.description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Grim Monolith that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Grim Monolith token.
Activate the Grim Monolith token's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3 using the other Grim Monolith token.
Repeat from step 2.

140-3887-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You have lost at least 4 life this turn.
Rowan does not have summoning sickness.
140-3887-4050.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn by at least {4}.
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {B} due to Rowan's ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

668-1494-2094.notablePrerequisites: Clearwater Goblet has at least five charge counters.
668-1494-2094.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Clearwater Goblet triggers, causing you to gain at least five life.
Activate Willowdusk by paying {1} and tapping it, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1534-4285.manaNeeded: {U}{U}{R}{R}, plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
1534-4285.notablePrerequisites: You have an additional instant and/or sorcery card in hand.
1534-4285.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying {R}{R}, targeting that spell.
Cast Twincast by paying {U}{U}, copying Increasing Vengeance, with the copy targeting Increasing Vengeance.
Resolve the copy of Increasing Vengeance, copying the original Increasing Vengeance, with the copy targeting the original Increasing Vengeance.
Repeat step 4.

914-2585-4013.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2585-4013.description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Dockside Extortionist, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping those, adding four mana of any color.
Activate Grim Monolith's last ability by paying {4}, untapping it.
Repeat.
